notes.title: Major renovation and update completed!
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for always playing "Uladrasill".
We would like to inform you that maintenance has ended at 17:00 on Friday, April 5th. 
We would also like to once again apologize for the postponement of the scheduled date and time.

As announced on SNS, etc., this maintenance included updates including large-scale balance adjustments.
There are a wide range of adjustment items, including the elimination of training elements, implementation of training mode, abolishment of gacha, and review of Jancy performance.
We have improved the quality as much as possible to make it more enjoyable for everyone, so we hope you will try it out.

[Update/adjustment items]
・Abolition of level and rarity
・Upward correction of Yakuman's damage compensation value
・Changes in skill production
- Adjusted some Jancy parameters.
・Implementation of overall skill adjustment
・Changes in season rewards
・Adjusted the luck correction value for each rank band
・Implementation of “Training”
・End of "Uradora Chip Gacha"
・End of "Junko Gacha"
・"Shop" lineup changes
・Changed the “Gacha” button to the “Cyber Tree” button
・Added "How to play" and "User information" buttons to the home page
・Delete the "Uradora Chip Gacha" and "Junko Gacha" buttons from the home page
・Home background design adjustment
・Added the status display of “In formation” and “Not in possession” in the Jhansi list
・Changed so that all of Jancy's performance is displayed.
・Changed the acquisition conditions for some badges
・Changed the rewards earned in ranked match battles
・Change of initial possession Jancy when creating a user
・Delete Uradora tip when creating a user
・Changed the Uradora chip lineup
・Changed default tiles

[For users who purchased Uradora Chip]
We have distributed the Uradora chips that have been consumed so far, please log in and check them out.
If you have any questions, please contact us using the flow below.

Contact flow
1.Click "Support" at the top of the title
2. Please check the displayed "Inquiry ID"
3.Click on "Support Page"
4. Please fill in the "Inquiry ID", "Email address", and "Inquiry details"
5. Once all the above steps are completed, please press "Send"

Once again, we have decided to perform maintenance for a long period of time, and we apologize for the inconvenience.
Please continue to enjoy the restarted “Uladrasil”.

Thank you for your continued support.

“Uladrasil” development management team
